objective: Test stability, auxiliary features and score combinations of the new tri-training hybrid.
fit_data: 157 gold and original masked training rows only; exclude masked duplicates of held-out embedding groups.
seed_policy: Use predetermined prefix ensembles of 3 or 5 seeds; never choose the best individual seed.
initial_method: Fixed prior label mask and decoding. Refine tri-training component only. Separately test global soft blending.
selection: Rank ordinary grouped CV and frozen robust training-only weighted CV; at most 4 distinct finalists, tested over three fresh repeats. Preserve baseline unless measured validation improves.
validation_policy: Freeze candidate configs and decoders before loading validation labels; no validation fitting, row corrections or seed selection.

sources.use: Motivation for aggregating unstable bootstrap predictors.
Future joint F1 decoder; old single-model GFM already tested, do not claim it is wholly new.
